name: Informative / Educational
description: Structured explanation with evidence, teaching order and accessible visuals.

stages.story: Separate known facts, uncertainty and examples; build a clear learning sequence.
stages.scene_direction: Use explanatory framing, readable visual hierarchy, demonstrations and explicit transitions.
stages.image: Prefer diagrams, labels, clean compositions and visual evidence that directly supports the explanation.
stages.audio: Use precise narration, deliberate pauses and restrained music below speech; effects clarify rather than distract.
stages.video: Use motion to demonstrate a process or relationship; preserve legibility and teaching order.
stages.review: Check factual support, terminology, pacing, accessibility and that visuals match the spoken explanation.
